rationale: E029 is the canonical form_value_imported value-split edge (R3). On a declared finite toy model run at two refinements, the chiral-Lagrangian SYMMETRY SKELETON (pions as Goldstone bosons of spontaneous chiral symmetry breaking) descends cleanly from QCD's chiral symmetry: the FORM leg's normalized residual xi_rel falls to machine-zero and stays there (form_tier E1, a coarse-graining physics already accepts -- this is also the is_rg_eft_descent textbook chiral-EFT move). But the edge's PRIMARY claim is the PREDICTIVE inter-layer connection, and that is incomplete without the low-energy constants (f_pi, the chiral condensate): these are run-generated numbers, non-definable from QCD's symmetry skeleton (the VALUE leg's xi_rel stays stably positive with analytic control), so claiming them as a descent would over-read QCD's Sigma_f (gate E.3). They close only by IMPORTING the lattice-QCD-run-generated LECs under the chiral-EFT matching assumption -- a named external principle (Step 2 recognition-search, smuggle-audit E.4 passing). Hence value_tier = E2, and per the R3 reported-tier rule for form_value_imported the reported (headline) tier IS the value_tier: scored_tier = E2. The primary modality is shadow-down (a structural descent test DID pass on the form leg, so by the B.7a precedence rule the structural modality is primary); recognition-conditional is a SECONDARY flag because the E2 headline leans on the named import. E029 is explicitly NOT a primary recognition-landing (it is outside recognition_resolution.affected_edges; C11 does not apply). The form-descends-E1 leg is recorded but NOT counted in the E1 null; the two legs are never summed.
self_audit: PRIMER-§9 CHECKLIST: (1) no unify-by-deriving -- this is a descent of FORM plus a recognized IMPORT of values, not a factorization of QCD into ChPT. (2) no derive-the-emergent-constant -- f_pi/condensate are explicitly NOT derived; they are imported as run-generated LECs (the run lives upstream in QCD). (3) no shortcut of a run -- the value leg's content is precisely the un-shortcuttable run-generated LECs. (4) not just-relabeling -- E.4 passes: removing the import kills the predictive relation; QCD and ChPT are distinct layers (different f, Sigma_f, a real symmetry-breaking quotient), not within-a-layer. (5) asymmetry kept -- arrow is DOWN (shadow); the FORM descends (runnable), and where the run-content surfaces it is IMPORTED, not run UP as a derivation. (6) emergence neither over-deflated nor over-inflated -- the LEC values are genuinely non-definable from QCD's skeleton (positive xi_rel), but here they are handled by a NAMED import, so the edge is E2, not E0. (7) scored on INTER-layer structure (descent legality of the form + recognition of the import), not intra-layer prediction. (8) E2 is an honest conditional landing, not a failure. OVER-READ CHECK: the decisive guard -- a naive small raw Xi on the form leg must NOT be read as E1 for the whole edge; the predictive content (the imported LECs, with hbar-scale/dimensional-transmutation magnitude NOT in QCD's Sigma_f closed-form predicates) is precisely what would be over-read if the edge were called E1. Reading xi_rel against the FULL target readout map (including the predictive LEC values, gate E.3) correctly blocks E1 and routes the headline to E2 via the import -- exactly the E005-style over-read lesson, applied here to the imported run-constants. DOUBT DIRECTION: no doubt-promotion; the E2 headline is the conservative reading of the predictive edge (E1 for the whole edge would be the flattering over-read, refused).
